items.statement: The submitted anion and neutral structures preserve the supplied 27-atom connectivity and the claimed optimized structures are checked with harmonic frequencies, with imaginary frequencies explicitly reported.
items.expected: A reproducible structure/state record and explicit imaginary-frequency lists; a completed minimum claim is supported only when no imaginary frequencies are reported.

items.statement: The spectrum comparison declares frequency scaling, line broadening, transition alignment, peak-selection and mode-assignment procedures.
items.expected: The report contains an auditable calculation record, alignment rule, peak-selection rule and mode displacement/intensity evidence.

items.statement: The particularly FC-active vibration is the third normal mode and is an in-plane bending mode.
items.expected: The report assigns its strongest supported progression to normal mode 3/in-plane bending, or explicitly reports a conflicting result and evidence.

items.statement: The calculation has a bounded spectral-comparison scope; not every observed band need be assigned, and diffuse DBS character and model/isomer limitations remain.
items.expected: The conclusion reports the actual comparison coverage and states appropriate unassigned-band/model limitations without inventing unavailable observations.
